_how: Each stock's earnings report dates, New York calendar days, e.g. "AAPL": ["2027-01-28"]. The bot makes no new entry on that stock from the trading day before a report to the trading day after it (schedule.earnings_days_before / _after). A date written "~2027-01-28" is an estimate: its pause is one trading day wider on each side. Replace an estimate with the company's confirmed date (drop the ~) once it is announced, usually 3-4 weeks ahead on its investor relations site. A stock not listed has no earnings pause.
_sources: Estimated on 2026-11-23 from third-party calendars and each company's date a year earlier (none confirmed yet): AAPL ~27-28 Jan (last year 29 Jan); MSFT ~27 Jan (28 Jan); META late Jan (28 Jan); TSLA ~27 Jan (28 Jan); AMD ~2 Feb (3 Feb); GOOGL early Feb (4 Feb); AMZN ~4 Feb (5 Feb); NVDA ~24 Feb (25 Feb; it reported Q3 on 17 Nov 2026). ANT (Anthropic, listed 17 Nov 2026) has no estimate: its first report is expected by 31 Mar 2027.
